misc: Loves basketball even more than Marcus, making some fans wonder if he's a real golfer
biography: Pasi stands as a uniquely energetic and captivating competitor within the storied chronicles of the Hector Trophée, bringing his refined golfing talents from the immaculate fairways of Vuosaari Golf Helsinki to the esteemed pair competition across four distinct editions. Affectionately known among his peers by the fierce moniker Susi-Pasi, this dedicated gentleman possesses an unyielding athletic passion that extends far beyond the links, nurturing an obsessive love for basketball that occasionally surpasses even his devotion to golf and leaves certain fans humorously wondering if he is indeed a true golfer at heart.

Within the grand context of the tournament, Pasi has etched his name permanently into the record books through stellar competitive achievements. He has tasted the ultimate glory of lifting the coveted Hector Trophée on one memorable occasion, triumphantly securing the prized team silverware. While the individual accolades represented by the Victor Trophy have thus far remained outside his personal collection across his four tournament appearances, his ongoing involvement in the vibrant community surrounding the event ensures that his compelling competitive journey remains fully open, leaving admirers in eager anticipation of his next masterclass on the course.
